description_en: Queries the configuration information of IPsec-VPN connections that are associated with transit router instances
description_zh: 调用DescribeVpnAttachments接口查询已绑定转发路由器实例的IPsec连接的配置信息
kebab_example: aliyun vpc describe-vpn-attachments --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --page-number 1 --page-size 10 --vpn-connection-id vco-p0w2jpkhi2eeop6q60000 --attach-type CEN --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeVpnAttachments

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the IPsec-VPN connection.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html operation to query the region ID
parameters.help_zh:
IPsec连接所属的地域ID。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html接口获取地域ID。
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page in paging queries. Default value: 10. Valid values: 1 to 50
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时每页的条目数。默认值：10。取值范围：1~50
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the IPsec-VPN connection.

If you do not specify an IPsec-VPN connection ID, the system queries all IPsec-VPN connections that are associated with transit router instances in the current region
parameters.help_zh:
IPsec连接ID。

如果您不输入IPsec连接ID，系统默认查询当前地域下所有已绑定转发路由器实例的IPsec连接的信息
parameters.name: vpn_connection_id

parameters.help_en:
The type of resource to which the IPsec-VPN connection is associated. Default value: CEN.

The value can only be CEN, which indicates that the system queries IPsec-VPN connections associated with transit router instances
parameters.help_zh:
IPsec连接绑定的资源类型。默认值：CEN。

仅取值：CEN，表示查询已绑定转发路由器实例的IPsec连接的信息
